Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWave Health — activation accelerator request

Daniel — great to speak this morning. As discussed, ClearWave has committed to a pilot (EAP) that starts the week of 2027-07-12 and they want specific guarantees for:

- per-tenant telemetry export (S3, daily)
- tenant-level isolation for a subset of traffic (routing + warm cache slot)
- audit logs with export window for SOC reviews
- ability to pin a quantized model variant for the pilot (lower-cost variant)

They've indicated that if we can commit to the above for the pilot they will convert to a paid contract with an expected ARR of ~$1.2M (first 12 months) and sign by 2027-08-01. Procurement will circulate a draft SOW shortly (I attached the proposal we shared).

Immediate ask to Product/Eng: can we evaluate prioritizing the three small-scope changes (telemetry export + tenant isolation + model pin) as a timeboxed activation accelerator for the 2027-07-12 pilot? Ideally an answer today/tomorrow so we can update the prospect and get procurement moving.

Attachments: CWH_EAP_PROPOSAL_v3.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks — short bullets on next steps appreciated.

--

On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 9:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Daniel — great to speak this morning...

Laura / Daniel — quick clarifying questions from Product so we scope the ask properly:

1) Telemetry export: what granularity and retention? Is a daily aggregated JSON (token-level counts + error rates) sufficient, or do they need full request-level logs for every call? Also which S3 bucket (they said they'd provide creds) and whether encryption must use customer-managed KMS.

2) Tenant isolation: you mentioned routing a subset of traffic to a warm cache slot. How many concurrent sessions/requests per second do we need to reserve for this pilot? We can do a soft guarantee (preferred) or a hard reservation (higher cost).

3) Model pin: do they require the exact binary pinned or a deterministic model config (e.g., quantized 8-bit variant of model-x)? We need to confirm model name and expected max sequence length.

If we can get those 3 answers I can write a concise product spec and estimate effort. From a prioritization perspective, these look like 2-3 week small scoped pieces if the telemetry is aggregated and the model pin is a config flag; tenant isolation is the trickiest depending on RPS.

Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: ClearWave Health — activation accelerator request

Ben / Laura / Daniel — engineering feasibility notes: 

- Telemetry export: we can deliver an aggregated daily export (token counts, latencies p50/p95, error classifications) to an S3 bucket using existing export pipeline. Estimated effort: 2 engineer-days to parameterize retention and KMS options + 1 day for testing. Full request-level exports are heavier (storage/cost + PII concerns); we'd need procurement sign-off.

- Tenant isolation / warm cache slot: we can provide a soft isolation lane (traffic routing + cache seeding) within 1 sprint (2 weeks) if the requested concurrency is <= 50 concurrent sessions or ~200 RPS burst. Hard reserved GPU slots with strict SLA would be a larger work item (4+ weeks) and require capacity planning in Dedicated pools.

- Model pin: if the quantized model binary is one of our supported variants we can pin via a config toggle; estimate 3 engineer-days to validate tokenization/latency impact. If the customer requires an unusual quantization or a custom fork, additional effort applies.

Risks: procurement requiring full request logs or requiring CMK with an HSM-backed KMS could extend timeline. Also need a JIRA to track design + QA: PROD-2151 (I've created a stub).

Suggested path: commit telemetry export + model-config pin for pilot (2 weeks), deliver soft tenant isolation for pilot (add routing + cache seeding) and agree with ClearWave on RPS limits. If revenue impact is material, we can propose a short capacity reservation addendum post-pilot.

Karthik
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Thanks — this is very helpful and much appreciated. To add clarity on the business side so Product/Eng can prioritize:

- Pilot start: target week of 2027-07-12.
- Contract timing: procurement indicated they need the tech commitments in writing to finalize SOW; expected signature target 2027-08-01.
- Revenue impact: conservative estimate ~$1.2M ARR if pilot converts; strategic reference for others in healthcare.

Answers to Ben's questions from ClearWave (procurement / Daniel):
> Telemetry: aggregated daily JSON export is sufficient for now. They DO want KMS with customer-managed keys (will provide an IAM/KMS contact).
> Isolation: target soft-reservation for 40 concurrent sessions, with a 200 RPS burst cap.
> Model pin: they want the quantized v2.1 of model-x (public variant) pinned via config.

Action items: 
- Ben: write a 1-page product spec and acceptance criteria for the pilot by end of day 6/15 so procurement has concrete language.
- Karthik: confirm the two-week delivery plan for telemetry + model-config pin and the soft-isolation routing (flag if >2 weeks).
- Monica: please prepare a short mutual action plan (timeline + success metrics) for the pilot and attach to the SOW.

If we can get product/eng alignment today, I'll message procurement and request they prioritize SOW finalization. Appreciate speedy confirmation — this is time-sensitive for the deal.
